name: antislop
description: Evidence-anchored chat indexing, self-recap, explicit decision and question transitions, nine-domain anti-slop audits, and regression checks.

interface.longDescription: Index accessible transcripts; reconcile questions, approvals, corrections and their provenance before auditing search, prose, concepts, Indonesian, naming, code, arguments and mathematics. Includes cross-plugin intent-substitution and unsupported-curriculum regression cases.
defaultPrompt: Audit this conversation for question drift, unsupported commitments, and slop. Summarize only accessible context.
Check my draft against the nine AntiSlop classes, showing evidence and minimal repairs.
Review this failed answer and convert the proven defect into a regression case.
